description.value: SWEET7 is a global mango drink and fruit tea chain founded in 2006, now operating over 1,500 stores worldwide. The Richmond location specializes in fresh-fruit beverages brewed without artificial flavourings, drawing on more than 20 award-winning flavour recipes. Cyclists passing through the Capstan Way corridor will find it a convenient stop for a cold drink.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 21m; rack at 50m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms SWEET7 is an active bubble tea and fruit drink chain with a Richmond location at 1131-8328 Capstan Wy, phone (604) 284-1568, corroborating the OSM record's website tag. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. OSM had no address or phone, both of which were sourced from the website's locations page.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website's locations page rather than OSM tags.
OSM name 'SWEET7' differs slightly from website branding 'Sweet 7 Canada' but appears intentional — the copyright footer uses 'SWEET7'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bubble tea cafe with an active website and confirmed Richmond location — straightforward inclusion.
